jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously.

What You’ll Do

Product Development Support

  • Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

  • Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

  • Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

  • Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, AI/ML, clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders, keeping a small team moving fast without sacrificing quality.

  • Contribute to go-to-market strategy, positioning, and customer enablement alongside commercial and clinical teams.

Analytics & Insights

  • Define and track meaningful product metrics; use data and user feedback to inform iteration and prioritization decisions.


What You Bring

  • 3-6 years of product management experience in a B2B or technical environment building products for specialized, professional users (not purely consumer products).

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex products where the user base has deep domain expertise, e.g., enterprise software, developer tools, scientific instruments, industrial platforms, or similar.

  • Strong conceptual and systems thinking. You can see the big picture, connect disparate inputs into a coherent product thesis, and reason about second-order effects. You don't just execute, you think.

  • Startup or high-growth experience. You have worked in an environment where speed, ambiguity, and wearing multiple hats were the norm, not the exception.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can write clearly, present a compelling argument, and facilitate productive discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort with technical depth. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to engage meaningfully with engineers and data scientists on architecture, data, and tradeoff discussions.

  • Intellectual curiosity and learning agility. You pick up new domains quickly and enjoy becoming a quasi-expert in areas you previously knew nothing about.

  • Fluency in English (native or professional proficiency required - C1 level or higher)

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, medtech, health-AI, or a regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with medical imaging, oncology workflows, or clinical decision support.

  • Experience working with AI/ML-driven products where model behavior shapes the user experience.

  • Exposure to FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking processes for software as a medical device (SaMD).

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline International Supply Team 👋
Trainline exists to make rail and coach travel easier for millions of customers across Europe - and the International Supply team is at the heart of making that possible. We work at the intersection of commercial partnerships, technical integrations, and customer experience, bringing new carriers and markets to life on the Trainline platform. The work we do shapes how customers across the continent discover, book, and travel - and there is plenty more to build.

As a Senior Product Manager in this team, you will own the end-to-end journey of bringing new markets onto the platform - from understanding the underlying customer problem through to how a new carrier or market shows up in the experience. You will work across two squads, going deep where it matters most, and collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver real impact at scale.


In this role as the Senior Product Manager, International Supply, you will... 🚄

  • Lead the discovery, scoping, and delivery of new market launches, owning the product strategy from initial problem framing through to customer-facing experience

  • Develop a deep understanding of how new carriers and markets are integrated into the Trainline platform, and ensure that complexity is invisible to the customer

  • Make informed investment decisions across the supply portfolio - balancing where to deepen existing integrations, where to improve what is already live, and where to prioritise launching net new markets or carriers

  • Work across two squads, managing priorities effectively across both while going deep on the areas of highest impact

  • Define and track the metrics that matter, building a clear point of view on what success looks like and why - and using data to drive decisions at every stage

  • Collaborate closely with Commercial colleagues to understand the economics of different markets, including commission structures and partner dynamics, ensuring product decisions are commercially grounded

  • Work across the full product stack, partnering with Engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities, particularly around API integrations with carrier and market partners

  • Embed AI tools and approaches into your ways of working to accelerate the speed at which value reaches our customers

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, GTM, and Marketing teams to ensure new market launches are set up for success from day one

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager working across multiple European markets, with a strong track record of launching or scaling products in a multi-market environment

  • The ability to understand the customer problem end to end - from how a market or carrier is integrated technically through to how that experience lands for the customer

  • Experience managing a portfolio of integrations or partnerships, with the judgement to assess where further investment will drive the most value versus where net new opportunities should be prioritised

  • A strong metrics mindset, with the ability to identify the right things to measure, articulate why they matter, and use insight to guide prioritisation and trade-offs

  • Solid understanding of APIs and how technical integrations work at a high level, with the confidence to engage meaningfully with Engineering teams on integration complexity

  • Experience working across multiple squads or workstreams simultaneously, with the organisational clarity to manage competing priorities without losing depth

  • Strong commercial awareness, including familiarity with commission structures, partner economics, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Commercial stakeholders

  • Confidence using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work, and a curiosity to keep developing in this area as the tooling evolves

  • Experience in or knowledge of the ground transport or travel industry is a plus, and will help you hit the ground running in this role

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor! 

Compensation: £90K • Offers Bonus

jobs.title: AI Program Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres Teams!


Wofür wir dich suchen

Als AI Program Manager (w/m/d) übernimmst du eine neu geschaffene Position und verantwortest den internen Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz bei catworkx, von der Ausrichtung über die Identifikation von Potenzialen bis zur Befähigung unserer Kolleg:innen. Im Mittelpunkt steht nicht der Showcase, sondern spürbarer Mehrwert im Arbeitsalltag und für unsere Kund:innen. Strukturen und Standards prägst du von Anfang an aktiv mit und hast entsprechend großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung.


Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du steuerst unsere AI-Aktivitäten, definierst Ausbaustufen und machst Adoption, Wirkung und Kosten über Kennzahlen transparent
  • Du bewertest mit den jeweiligen Teams mögliche Use Cases, priorisierst sie und baust Prototypen selbst mit Low-Code- und No-Code-Tools
  • Du überführst erprobte Ansätze in langfristig tragfähige Automatisierungen, Skills und Agenten, jeweils mit eindeutiger Ownership und zentraler Bereitstellung
  • Du treibst unser Zielbild einer deutlich stärkeren Nutzung von Anthropic Claude neben unserer bestehenden internen AI-Lösung voran und achtest auf Sicherheit sowie breite Zugänglichkeit
  • Du konzipierst Enablement-Formate für Führungskräfte, Power User und alle Mitarbeitenden, setzt sie mit unserer Academy um und bist Anlaufstelle für AI-Fragen im ganzen Haus
  • Du bereitest Entscheidungen zur Werkzeuglandschaft vor, behältst API- und Token-Ausgaben im Blick und gewährleistest mit unserem AI Compliance Management die Konformität mit der EU-KI-Verordnung
  • Deine ersten sechs Monate
Ein Vorschlag, kein Pflichtenheft: Den konkreten Zuschnitt legen wir gemeinsam mit dir fest.
  • Monat 1 bis 2: Gespräche mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern sowie eine Bestandsaufnahme von Software, Lizenzen und Budgets. Ergebnis: eine dokumentierte Ausgangslage und eine bereinigte Übersicht des vorhandenen Backlogs
  • Monat 2 bis 3: Entwurf für AI-Strategie und Roadmap, ein Portfolio mit Fokus auf den Vertrieb sowie ein Konzept zur Erfolgsmessung
  • Monat 3 bis 4: Zwei bis drei Pilotprojekte daraus sind umgesetzt, klein, schnell und mit sichtbarem Ergebnis. Außerdem finden Office Hours regelmäßig statt
  • Monat 4 bis 6: Mindestens eine Anwendung läuft stabil im Regelbetrieb und liefert belastbare Resultate, der Schwerpunkt Delivery beginnt, das Ambassador-Programm startet und die Leitung erhält ein strukturiertes Reporting
Du beginnst dabei nicht bei null
In dieser Zeit begleitet dich eine Mentorin unseres Schwesterunternehmens CLOUDPILOTS, das denselben Aufbau bereits durchlaufen hat und seine Erfahrungen direkt mit dir teilt. Intern kannst du zudem auf einen eingespielten Innovationsprozess, ein Ideen-Board, einen Innovation Hub und ein engagiertes AI Chapter zurückgreifen.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsprozessen und Technologie mit, etwa aus Consulting, Anforderungsmanagement, Projektleitung oder Product Ownership, und hast in einer größeren Organisation bereits ein Thema von Grund auf etabliert
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit LLMs wie ChatGPT, Copilot oder Gemini und realisierst damit eigenständig Vorhaben im Unternehmenskontext
  • Du rechnest Business Cases, weist Effizienzgewinne belegbar nach und kennst die Grundlagen von AI-Governance und Datenschutz
  • Du packst Dinge eigeninitiativ und umsetzungsstark an, erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und begeisterst Menschen für Veränderungen
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch, Kenntnisse in Atlassian-Produkten oder Rovo sind ein Plus, aber kein Ausschlusskriterium


Was wir dir bieten

  • Workation bietet dir die Möglichkeit, mobil aus dem EU-Ausland oder den EFTA-Staaten zu arbeiten
  • Möglichkeiten wie z.B. Leasemybike oder Klimaticket sorgen für deine Mobilität
  • Mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten sorgt für deine optimale Work-Life Integration
  • Regelmäßige Aus- und Weiterbildungen und Förderung individueller Zertifizierungen bringen dich weiter
  • Deine Empfehlungen honorieren wir mit einer Prämie (Mitarbeitenden-Empfehlungsprogramm)
  • Gesundheitsangebote im Bereich Mental Health und Ersparnisse in der Gruppenkrankenversicherung stehen dir zur Verfügung


Über uns

catworkx ist einer der größten Atlassian Platinum und Enterprise Solution Partner in der DACH-Region, mit Standorten in Deutschland (Hamburg, München, Köln, Stuttgart), Österreich (Wien) und in der Schweiz (Winterthur, Luzern), der sich zu 100 Prozent auf Atlassian-Lösungen spezialisiert hat. Wir sind Atlassian-Partner und Marketplace-App-Anbieter der ersten Stunde und gehören bereits seit 2002 zu den führenden Dienstleistern im deutschsprachigen Raum. Unser Leistungsangebot, für die gesamte Atlassian Produktpalette, ist ganzheitlich und umfasst die Prozessberatung und -Implementierung, App-Entwicklung, Plattformlösungen für den Betrieb, offizielle Atlassian-Trainings sowie umfassende Lizenzierungsdienstleistungen.

Wir sind stolz darauf, kürzlich von Atlassian weltweit als Partner of the Year 2024 - 2025 im Bereich High Velocity Service Management ausgezeichnet worden zu sein.

catworkx ist Teil der TIMETOACT GROUP - einem der führenden IT Dienstleister für Cloud-Plattformen und digitale Lösungen. Mit mehr als 1.700 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten wir in 25 Städten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie in Niederlassungen in Italien, den Niederlanden, Spanien und den USA. Ergänzt wird unser Netzwerk durch Service Hubs in Mittelamerika, Mittel- und Osteuropa sowie Südostasien.
 
Für dich bedeutet das u.a.: vielfältige Karrierewege, Zugang zu Academy-Angeboten und unserer GROUP-weiten Initiative für Frauen, attraktive Benefits und Events – und das gute Gefühl, in einem starken Netzwerk zu arbeiten, das Zusammenhalt großschreibt. Feel the WE in IT.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit within the Shopping team, reporting to the Lead Product Manager. The Shopping team turns travel supply into accurate, commercially optimised, bookable and payable holidays. It provides shared data and services that help customers, teams and partners make better selling decisions.

On the payments side, you’ll work closely with Engineering and Commercial Payments to own product strategy and delivery for the Payments platform. Together, the team will make it easier for other teams to offer, operate and improve payments without rebuilding the same logic in each customer journey. You will:

  • Build a flexible international payments platform: Define the shared services, data and APIs that meet local customer and market needs, while allowing payment methods to be launched and managed consistently across markets and customer journeys

  • Create reliable foundations: Improve the payment data, provider integrations and fraud controls that keep payments secure, dependable and easier to manage

  • Make payment methods easier to launch: Help teams configure, test and release supported methods safely, with less engineering work and clearer ownership

  • Enable payment optimisation at scale: Provide shared data and platform capabilities that help teams improve payment success and offer relevant payment methods across markets and journeys. Apply AI to improve insight and enable responsible automation where it delivers measurable value

Your day-to-day:

  • Working with your lead engineer and stakeholders to set the Payments vision, roadmap and success measures

  • Working with market experts, commercial teams and Customer Product teams to understand payment needs. Provide data to inform their decisions and translate agreed requirements into reusable platform capabilities

  • Exposing reliable payment data and provider insights so teams can understand failures, drop-off, acceptance rates and customer pain points. Work with those teams to prioritise the platform improvements needed to improve payment performance

  • Leading delivery: Lead work across payment services, provider integrations, payment data, configuration and fraud controls. Keep the platform straightforward for other teams to use

  • Working directly with payment providers and aggregators to solve issues, evaluate new capabilities and hold partners to the standards customers need

  • Explaining trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and building agreement on decisions that span several teams

Your skillset:

  • Platform product experience: You have owned a technical, API-led, data-rich or internal platform product that is used by more than one team or customer journey and involves a payments ecosystem

  • Systems thinking: You can understand how payment data, provider integrations, customer journeys, commercial rules and operational processes fit together, then turn that into reusable product capabilities

  • Technical fluency: You can work closely with engineers on APIs, integration patterns, data models, reliability, observability, security and migration work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can make sound product trade-offs with them

  • Payments and commercial judgement: You understand the payment ecosystem and how method availability, payment success, fraud, cost and customer trust affect growth

  • Data-led problem solving: You are comfortable using data to investigate problems, define useful measures and judge whether a change is improving payment performance

  • Customer empathy: You understand that payments can be stressful, especially when people are making high-value holiday purchases or managing payments after booking. You use this to advocate for clear, dependable journeys

  • Strong delivery and communication: You can lead complex work through ambiguity, make priorities clear and bring technical, commercial and operational stakeholders with you. You deliver iteratively, focusing each step on meaningful value while keeping the team aligned to a clear long-term direction

  • AI literacy: You use AI tools confidently and can demonstrate their impact. You understand their strengths and limitations and can apply them responsibly to improve your work and payment capabilities

The interview journey:

  • Talent intro, 30 minutes

  • First stage with the hiring manager, 45 minutes

jobs.title: Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
jobs.description:

Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin.

Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux.

Vos responsabilités

  • Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.
  • Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques.
  • Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient.

  • Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement.

Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit.

Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur.

L'objectif n'est pas seulement de produire des spécifications mais d'être capable de rendre rapidement une idée tangible, afin de mieux collaborer avec les utilisateurs, les designers et les ingénieurs.

Requirements

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

  • Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

  • Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

  • Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

  • Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

  • Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

  • Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

  • Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

  • Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

  • Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

  • Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

  • Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

  • Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

  • Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

  • Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

  • Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

  • Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Founding Engineer at SANOVIO, you will play a key role in building the AI-powered procurement infrastructure that tackles one of the biggest and most complex cost problems in European healthcare.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for engineers with high agency, strong technical depth, and a founder mindset. We’re looking for a full-stack generalist with a strong frontend affinity. You excel at designing user flows and implementing them in React and TypeScript, while owning outcomes end-to-end across backend, data, AI-enabled workflows, and cloud deployment. You thrive amid uncertainty and incomplete requirements, move quickly, and still care deeply about architecture, clean code, and long-term quality.

If you are a passionate builder who thrives at the intersection of full-stack development and AI, this is your opportunity to work closely with the founders, shape the product, and help us scale toward €10M ARR in 2026.

Tasks

  • Owning end-to-end product workflows, from frontend UX to backend systems, data pipelines, and edge cases

  • Building world-class frontend experiences in React and TypeScript alongside scalable, reliable backend systems

  • Designing and owning AI-enabled systems, including embeddings, retrieval, and agents that create real operational leverage

  • Developing and operating data pipelines for large-scale unstructured data

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions on architecture, tools, and frameworks to balance speed and quality

  • Deploying, running, and maintaining software in cloud environments with a “you ship it, you run it” mindset

  • Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with scalable, reusable components and APIs

  • Collaborating across the stack and raising the engineering bar through reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership

General Profile

We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in full-stack software engineering and AI, and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future. 3–5 years of experience is a plus, but we hire for skill, ownership, and output.

  • Generalist engineer with a frontend affinity, capable of building across backend, data, and AI

  • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong problem-solving ability and fast adoption of new technologies

  • Motivation to build excellent software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Willingness to work in-person in Munich with a higher intensity than a traditional 9–5 role

Technical skillset

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Solid backend engineering skills, ideally with Node.js, and experience designing APIs and data model

  • Proven track record of architecting and building production-grade software systems

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

  • AI experience is a plus, especially embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling, evals, and agentic workflows beyond prompt engineering

Leadership and communication

  • You naturally take responsibility and enjoy leading

  • You’re one of the strongest engineers in the team and make everyone else better

  • Everyone can come to you for advice on how to fix their hardest problems

  • You communicate clearly and are credible with technical stakeholders and clients

Bonus if you

  • Can share a portfolio of projects, shipped products, or a GitHub with meaningful work

  • Have experience scaling systems from early usage to larger production workloads

  • Have built workflow-heavy B2B products, internal tools, or operations software

  • You are business proficient in Chinese

Benefits

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly Wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope & travel

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

  • Meaningful compensation package including cash, performance bonus, and shares (Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations).


About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

The technical interview consists of two parts:

  • A take-home exercise, including a short presentation

  • A system design interview

For the take-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. You’ll have 2–3 hours to complete it, focusing on a real SANOVIO workflow and user flow in React and TypeScript, with a light end-to-end angle such as API integration, data modeling, edge cases, and clean architecture. Later, you’ll present your results to us.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & Reference Checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

jobs.title: Head of Product (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

 

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As our Head of Product (f/m/d), you'll shape what an AI-first product for the trades can become — and turn that ambition into products used by tradespeople across Europe.

We're moving beyond software that digitises administrative work towards software that increasingly does the work itself: answering calls a busy shop can't get to, turning information from the job site into quotes, keeping invoicing moving, and helping business owners understand where their attention is needed. The challenge is to make these capabilities part of one coherent product experience — not simply add AI features to an existing product.

The playbook for software that runs a trades business for its owner doesn't exist yet. You'll play a key role in shaping it.

And the timing matters: we already have a substantial customer base, we're expanding into new European markets, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. AI is fundamentally changing what's possible for our customers, while our existing scale means the decisions you make can reach real businesses quickly.

You'll lead our Product Management and UX teams and turn company strategy into focused product execution. You'll define where AI meaningfully changes the customer experience, drive priorities and trade-offs across our core product, AI capabilities, and European markets, and set the bar for products customers can trust even when the underlying technology is probabilistic.

At the same time, you'll shape how Product works at plancraft: developing a strong Product and UX organisation, bringing teams closer to customers and outcomes, and creating the clarity and ownership needed to move fast.

Your Responsibilities

  • Make AI the product, not a feature. Define where AI can fundamentally change how tradespeople run their businesses and translate those opportunities into coherent product experiences across our platform.

  • Set the bar for trustworthy AI products. Own how we approach AI quality, reliability, evaluation, and decision boundaries — ensuring customers can confidently rely on the capabilities we put into their hands.

  • Turn strategy into focus. Translate company strategy into a prioritised product portfolio and clear team outcomes, driving prioritisation and trade-off decisions across markets, platform, and AI.

  • Lead Product Management and UX as one function. Directly lead around nine PMs and designers, raise the bar on product thinking, develop their capabilities, and strengthen ownership across the organisation.

  • Build outcome-oriented product teams. Continue the shift from domains and output towards teams that own customer problems and outcomes, stay close to real tradespeople through discovery, data, and experimentation, and have the autonomy to act on what they learn.

  • Build for Europe. Scale the product across markets, balancing shared foundations with the customer and market needs that genuinely differ.

  • Create a product organisation that moves with clarity. Establish a pragmatic operating model, clear decision-making rhythms, and strong interfaces across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM — with product and customer outcomes as the measure of success and commercial outcomes co-owned with GTM.

The scoreboard — how we'll know it's working

  • Autopilot penetration & hours given back — the share of the real work (quotes, scheduling, invoicing, materials) our AI runs end-to-end and the customer keeps — not reworks — and the admin hours that hands back to every business.

  • Net revenue retention & AI-driven expansion — customers who stay and grow because the AI pays for itself, with usage- and outcome-based revenue as new capabilities land (co-owned with GTM).

  • Time-to-first-value, in every market — how fast a new business — in Germany, Italy or Spain — reaches its first AI-sent quote or automated invoice, with onboarding that stays light.

  • Feature impact ratio — the share of what we ship that actually moves its target outcome: the number that keeps us a product team, not a feature factory.

Your Profile

  • You've led product in high-growth B2B SaaS on a similar level, with PMs — and ideally UX/design — reporting to you.

  • You've built (AI) products where the intelligence is the value — not internal productivity tooling or a bolt-on feature. You know how designing on top of probabilistic, fast-moving models changes discovery, UX, iteration, reliability, and the economics of the product.

  • You've built and scaled software products across multiple international markets, and understand how product strategy, customer needs, and execution change as the business expands.

  • You turn strategy into execution. You have a strong bias to ship, make the necessary trade-offs, and own them.

  • You've moved teams from output to outcomes and led them through meaningful organisational and product change.

  • You lead directly and pragmatically — adding structure where it helps and removing it where it doesn't.

  • You're fluent in English (C1/C2); German is a real plus. You're based in Germany and can spend around minimum a week per month with the team in Hamburg (which can also be split across the month).

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for an experienced Product leader who combines strong Product craft, organisational leadership, and a bias towards execution.

You’re comfortable moving between strategy and the actual product: shaping priorities with senior leadership, developing strong PMs and designers, challenging trade-offs, and staying close enough to customers and technology to build strong Product judgement.

You’ll thrive here if you’re excited by the opportunity to shape an AI-first product at meaningful scale, evolve how a Product organisation works, and help build a product that can serve tradespeople across Europe.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

  • Die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen zu strukturieren, zu priorisieren und für Entwicklungsteams verständlich aufzubereiten.
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams sowie unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern auf Fach- und Managementebene
  • Analytisches Denken sowie Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Interpretation von Reports und Auswertungen.
  • Eine eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, hohe Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Darum wir

  • Flexibles Arbeiten in unserem wunderschönen neuen Büro in der Friedrichstraße
  • 32 Tage Urlaub sowie die Möglichkeit auch länger verreisen zu können
  • Während der Einarbeitung begleitet dich dein*e persönliche*r Onboarding-Buddy
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Deutschlandticket Job, Weiterbildungen (IT&I Campus, Konferenzen, Bücher) uvm.
  • Mitgliedschaft beim Urban Sports Club – trainiere flexibel in zahlreichen Sport- und Wellness-Einrichtungen
  • Leckerer Kaffee, Getränke und Obst stehen dir im Büro zur Verfügung und unterstützen deine Kreativität
  • Spielkonsole oder unser kleines Kino kannst du zum Austausch nutzen
  • Auf Firmen- und Teamevents, wie Sommer- und Weihnachtsfesten, kannst du mit uns Erfolge feiern oder dich sportlich beim Beachvolleyball oder Firmenläufen auspowern
  • Du erhältst außerdem eine unbefristete Anstellung und eine attraktive Vergütung in einem sicheren und gesund wachsenden Unternehmen

jobs.title: Team Lead Website
jobs.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Team Lead Website to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.
