jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform
jobs.description:
Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £110,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £80K – £110K

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.

  • Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.

  • Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.

  • Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.

  • Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.

  • Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Business Development Representative - French Speaking
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a highly motivated, outgoing, and tech-savvy sales representative with strong business acumen to join our growing Business Development team. As a Business Development Representative, you will generate new business by prospecting outbound leads through cold outreach and work collaboratively across our sales organization to set high-value meetings. This is a highly strategic role that requires creativity, resilience, and the ability to partner effectively with an Account Executive to create new business opportunities. This is a fully in-office role supporting our EMEA team.

Joining the Business Development team is an opportunity to fast-track your career in sales. Applicants should have a growth mindset and be excited to work collaboratively across the Revenue organization. You will learn consultative selling and hone in on our best-in-class outbound motion to execute our sales strategy. High performers in the BDR role will open up new opportunities for career growth within our rapidly growing organization.

We’re looking for a customer-focused, highly motivated, and driven individual with a desire to grow and advance in a career in sales. If you have a proactive and customer-first mentality with the passion to demonstrate Zip’s commitment to our merchants, we’d love to talk to you!

You Will

  • Partner closely with our VP of Sales and Account Executives to identify and source meetings that lead to pipeline and closed revenue

  • Prospect across a high volume of accounts, with a keen eye on strategically prioritizing your time

  • Become a market expert – researching and understanding our target industries and personas, and what makes them tick

  • Build a point of view on how to help customers with their needs and the right qualifying questions to ask

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 6-12+ months or equivalent sales experience

  • French Fluency required

  • A consistent track record of meeting and exceeding goals

  • Be a highly strategic thinker and problem solver with a solutions first and adaptable mindset

  • Ability to work from our office off of Kings Cross station, 4-5 days a week. Opportunity to move to a hybrid scheduled once hitting quota! 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, ScratchPad, Gong, and/or SalesNavigator

  • Tech experience or proven success in a fast-paced environment

  • A strong passion for fintech is a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a paramount focus on detail

  • An ability to celebrate change and embrace accountability

Within 2 weeks, you will...

  • Complete Zip’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Zip team members

  • Gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development on key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development to discuss your personal and professional goals

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Your mission

As our Application Security Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and strengthening the security of our products and platforms. Working closely with highly skilled engineering, platform, and security teams, you will help build secure, resilient, and trusted software while driving a security-first culture across the organization. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on modern products, influence security strategy, and continuously develop your expertise in a collaborative and innovative environment.

  • Drive product security across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Perform threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security assessments for applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and support the remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • Integrate, operate, and continuously improve security tooling within CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency scanning, and secrets-scanning solutions.
  • Define, promote, and support secure coding standards and security best practices across engineering teams.
  • Review and advise on authentication, authorization, identity management, secrets management, and service-to-service communication designs.
  • Support penetration testing activities, conduct targeted security testing, and drive remediation efforts.
  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and security awareness initiatives.
  • Partner closely with software engineers, architects, and platform teams to embed security into development processes and strengthen our DevSecOps culture.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Software Security, Secure Software Development, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development practices and common application security vulnerabilities.
  • Proven experience performing threat modeling, architecture reviews, code reviews, and application security assessments.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency-scanning, and secrets-scanning tools.
  • Strong knowledge of application security, API security, and distributed-system security.
  • Experience securing authentication, authorization, and identity-related workflows.
  • Solid understanding of OWASP, CWE, security testing methodologies, and modern security engineering practices.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and applying DevSecOps principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering, platform, and DevOps teams.

  • Development experience in C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience securing cloud-native applications and services in Azure and/or AWS environments.

  • Experience working in agile software development environments.


Why us?

jobs.title: UAS Instructor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a UAS Training Instructor, you will play a critical role within our Training, Demonstration, and Documentation team. Through close collaboration with defence, government, and public safety customers across the UK and internationally, you will become a key representative of Quantum-Systems. Your expertise and ability to deliver high-quality training will ensure customers can safely, effectively, and confidently operate our unmanned aerial systems (UAS).

In this customer-facing role, you will lead training programmes and product demonstrations for operators, military personnel, law enforcement agencies, and senior stakeholders. You will work closely with the Government Sales team to support customer engagement, showcase operational capabilities, and contribute to the continued success of Quantum-Systems in the UK and international defence markets.

Your Day-to-Day Mission

Prepare and Maintain UAS Operational Readiness

  • Ensure all UAS platforms, payloads, and supporting equipment are fully operational and ready for customer demonstrations and training activities worldwide.

  • Conduct pre-deployment inspections, system checks, and troubleshooting to maintain the highest levels of operational readiness.

Develop and Maintain Training Programmes

  • Support in creating, updating, and continuously improving training materials, including manuals, presentations, lesson plans, and practical exercises.

  • Support in ensuring training content remains aligned with product developments, operational requirements, and customer needs.

Deliver Practical Flight Training

  • Lead classroom and field-based training primarily on fixed-wing UAS platforms

  • Instruct customers on mission planning, pre-flight preparation, flight operations, emergency procedures, post-flight activities, and data exploitation.

  • Promote best practices for operational safety and mission effectiveness.

Evaluate Learner Performance

  • Assess participants during both theoretical and practical training exercises.

  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching to support competence development and operational proficiency.

  • Maintain accurate training records and certification documentation where required.

Conduct Professional Product Demonstrations

  • Deliver engaging and impactful demonstrations to prospective customers and stakeholders.

  • Use your operational experience to effectively communicate real-world use cases and mission benefits.

  • Present confidently to audiences ranging from end users and operators to senior military officers, procurement officials, and government decision-makers.



What you bring to the team:

  • Military, law enforcement, intelligence, or other government service background, ideally with operational deployment experience.

  • Proven experience delivering training to defence, security, public safety, or government organisations.

  • You already have, or have the ability to acquire, Multi rotor and Fixed wing UAS licenses within the UK and Europe.

  • Ideally, experience operating and instructing on fixed-wing UAS platforms

  • Strong presentation, communication, and instructional skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • The ability to independently plan, deliver, and evaluate training programmes in English. Additional language skills would be advantageous.

  • A professional and confident manner when interacting with senior military, government, and security stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

  • Willingness to travel extensively within the UK and internationally, including to remote and challenging operational environments.

  • Experience working in multinational and multicultural environments is desirable.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

As Sales Manager for the French Market at Amenitiz, your primary objective is to ensure the day-to-day execution, coaching, and operational stability of a small, focused French sales team based in our new Lyon hub. You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development.

You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results.

We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners.

This is a newly created role opening our first commercial hub in France. You won't start from a blank page: you'll inherit an existing customer base, pipeline, tools, sales methodology, and the full support of the wider commercial team in Barcelona.

Your mission

  • Build and grow the Lyon team: recruit, train, and manage a team of SDRs, BDRs, and AEs

  • Run daily execution: manage pipeline health, call activity, and meeting volume across the team

  • Coach in the detail: listen to calls, give real-time feedback, and identify patterns that slow conversion

  • Hire and onboard: bring in the right profiles and get them productive quickly

  • Hold performance: track individual KPIs at every level, have honest conversations early, and support people to improve

  • Act as the link between the team and leadership: surface what is working, flag what is not, and translate direction into daily habits

  • Drive pipeline generation through a mixed approach (roughly 80% outbound, 20% inbound), with a short sales cycle (typically 1-2 weeks, up to one month)

  • Build a repeatable sales playbook to accelerate and scale the French market

  • Maintain HubSpot hygiene: ensure the team logs accurately so pipeline data can be trusted

  • Collaborate with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, and align outreach quality with closing requirements between SDRs, BDRs, and AEs

About you

  • 3+ years of experience managing a sales team, ideally in a SaaS, tech, or B2B environment (independent businesses/SMEs)

  • Native French speaker with strong written and verbal English (B1/B2 minimum)

  • Confirmed skills in outbound prospecting (cold calling) and short sales-cycle selling

  • Comfortable with HubSpot and Aircall (or similar tools)

  • You are a coach first: you get energy from developing people, not from being the best seller in the room

  • Strong organisational skills - you can manage a small team across multiple roles without losing track of the detail

  • Comfortable in a performance-oriented environment where targets are clear and accountability is real

  • Entrepreneurial, resilient, and autonomous, with genuine appetite for building a team "from scratch"

  • Experience in hospitality tech, online travel, or B2B SaaS is an advantage

Our offer

  • Competitive OTE - base salary plus performance-based commission

  • Stock options with a progressive vesting schedule

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • 25 days of holidays from day one, rising to 28 after your first year and 30 after two years

  • €10 a day for lunch through our virtual canteen, Kombo, every day you work from the office

  • Flexible benefits - save on meals, childcare, transportation, and training with our tailored remuneration options

  • On-demand salary access - no need to wait until the end of the month

  • Any book, purchased for you, plus access to a shared team library

  • An international team of 35+ nationalities based in one of Europe's leading tech hubs

jobs.title: Performance and Data Engineer F/H - CDI - Toulouse, Montpellier, Paris
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. 

 

Vos missions principales seront :  

 

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord.  
  • Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales.  
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes.  
  • Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI.  
  • Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès.  
  • Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision.  
  • Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation.  
  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques.  
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue : fiabilité des installations, animation de groupes de travail.  
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations contractuelles du prestataire SCADA en phase d’exploitation. 

 

 

HSE : 

 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

 

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

  

 

 

 

Qualité : 

 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

Requirements

Votre profil : 

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. 

Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations. 

À l’aise dans les échanges, vous êtes reconnu.e pour vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Vous savez également prendre des décisions rapidement lorsque la situation l’exige. 

Un bon niveau d’anglais technique est attendu afin de pouvoir évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. 

Une première expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables serait un véritable atout, mais c’est avant tout votre curiosité, votre autonomie et votre envie de relever des défis techniques qui feront la différence ! 

 

Localisation et déplacements : 

Le poste implique des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites de l’entreprise à travers la France, représentant environ 25 % du temps de travail. 

Vous êtes donc mobile et appréciez le fait de pouvoir alterner entre travail au bureau et interventions directement sur le terrain.

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

 

 

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat    
  • L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an    
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité  
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   
  • Très bonne couverture mutuelle (famille incluse) et Prévoyance    

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

jobs.description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

⚡️ Le rôle

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux.


🎯 Vos missions

🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance

  • Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités
  • Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées
  • Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance

    • 📈 Développer votre portefeuille

    • Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation
    • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client
    • Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres
    • Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention

      • 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention

      • Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement
      • Détecter tôt les signaux faibles de churn et sauver les comptes à risque
      • Suivre et analyser votre performance avec votre manager pour progresser en continu

        • 🔗 Être la voix de la trésorerie chez Agicap

        • Trouver le bon équilibre entre la mise en avant du produit et le bon timing : notre produit évolue vite, à vous de fixer les bonnes attentes avec vos clients
        • Identifier les besoins d'activation ou de paramétrage et les transmettre à l'équipe Onboarding
        • Partager vos retours terrain avec les équipes CS et Produit pour améliorer nos process et notre produit

👀 Votre profil
  • Vous avez une solide expertise en trésorerie / cash management, acquise en direction trésorerie, en conseil, en banque ou chez un éditeur de logiciels trésorerie / finance
  • Vous savez expliquer et challenger des sujets comme les prévisions de trésorerie, le BFR, le cash pooling, la connectivité bancaire ou la consolidation multi-entités
  • Vous avez fait vos preuves dans un rôle client avec des objectifs commerciaux (account management, upsell, renouvellements ou business development), et vous savez mener une bonne découverte
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec des décideur·ses finance exigeant·es et vous savez conduire des négociations complexes
  • Vous êtes moteur de votre propre montée en compétences : résilient·e, vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et vous vous remettez en question en permanence
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement qui va vite, où tout n'est pas encore parfait
  • Vous avez un fort esprit d'équipe et vous aimez partager vos connaissances
  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais

    • ⭐️ Bonus : une expérience sur un TMS ou un ERP (Kyriba, SAP, Sage, Cegid…), une connaissance de l'environnement SaaS, de la rigueur dans l'utilisation d'un CRM (HubSpot / Salesforce)


🔥 Pourquoi rejoindre Agicap ?
  • Mettre votre expertise trésorerie au cœur d'un rôle commercial, avec un produit conçu pour les équipes finance
  • Rejoindre une équipe à fort impact, dans une phase clé de structuration : un gros challenge et une vraie contribution à apporter
  • Un package fixe + variable, qui récompense à la fois l'expansion et la rétention — à confirmer

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

  • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

  • Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

  • UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

  • Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

  • Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

Nice to Have

  • Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

  • Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

  • Building a design system from scratch.

  • Defence or regulated customers.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Optical Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Principal Optical Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, design, modeling, integration, characterization, and validation of advanced optical microsystems and photonic test solutions. This senior individual-contributor role owns complex development efforts from concept through production release and applies deep expertise in optics and photonics to resolve multidisciplinary technical challenges.

This is an on-site position based in Karlsruhe, Germany, where Keystone does exciting work on advanced 3D-printed micro-optics and optical probe heads. The role is part of our parent company, FormFactor, and will work in close collaboration with a team on the U.S. West Coast. Candidates should be willing to travel to the U.S. several times per year.

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design debug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Tasks

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across engineering, manufacturing, quality, software, and commercial teams; translate customer and product needs into system requirements; and establish robust design, simulation, test, and validation methods. This role influences technical roadmaps and engineering practices through expertise and collaboration rather than direct people management.

Optical System Architecture and Product Development

• Lead development of advanced optical systems, micro-optical components, and photonic test solutions from concept through commercial deployment.

• Translate customer, product, and application requirements into system architectures, performance specifications, interfaces, and verification plans.

• Own system-level optical performance and manufacturability, reliability, cost, schedule, and scalability of optical subsystems.

• Drive technical decisions for complex programs with significant ambiguity, multidisciplinary dependencies, and business impact.

• Collaborate closely with Mechanical and Controls engineering teams to integrate optical components into precision alignment systems.

• Select and characterize subsystem optical components including fiber array units (FAUs) and optical connectors.

• Apply structured design reviews, risk assessment, and requirements traceability throughout the product lifecycle.

Simulation, Modeling, and Analysis

• Develop and validate advanced optical models using wave optics, diffraction, beam propagation, and photonic-device simulation methods.

• Perform tolerance analysis, sensitivity analysis, error budgeting, and performance prediction for complete optical systems.

• Correlate simulation results with laboratory measurements, production data, and field performance.

Test, Metrology, and Automation

• Lead development of optical characterization techniques, measurement methods, fixtures, and system-level verification strategies.

• Define automated test and data-acquisition approaches supporting development, manufacturing, and quality assurance.

• Integrate advanced metrology, image processing, and in-line monitoring solutions for process control and performance verification.

• Use statistical analysis and data-driven methods to improve repeatability, capability, yield, and product performance.

Requirements

• Degree or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of relevant experience in optical-system development, photonics, semiconductor

equipment, or test and measurement. Equivalent combinations of education and industry experience may be considered.

• Deep expertise in wave optics, optical-system analysis, and photonic devices.

• Demonstrated success leading complex technical projects from concept through implementation or product release.

• Strong experience with optical modeling, simulation, tolerance analysis, and experimental correlation.

• Hands-on experience developing and validating optical test and measurement methodologies.

• Proven ability to independently solve complex, multidisciplinary problems and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• Experience with silicon photonics, photonic integrated circuits, or wafer-level optical testing.

• Demonstrated experience in optical design and analysis using ANSYS Zemax.

• Knowledge of advanced microfabrication, additive manufacturing, cleanroom, or semiconductor process technologies.

• Experience with precision optical alignment, opto-mechanical systems, packaging, and system integration.

• Programming and automation experience using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with machine vision, image processing, automated inspection, statistical process control, or design of experiments.

Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonus structure.

• The opportunity to work on leading semiconductor test technology in the growing photonics industry.

• A pleasant working environment in Karlsruhe, including access to a canteen.

• A supportive and international team culture.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

TL;DR: Our graduate roles are about who we believe you can become, not your previous experiences and qualifications. Everyone has to take the first step somewhere and we’re excited about creating this environment.

You'll walk into some of the world's most complex enterprise systems and deploy Conduct against the challenges our customers face. You build the kind of trust that turns an initial pilot into a long-term partnership - and the product insights you bring back will directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks. You join strategic accounts early, run the technical deployment hands-on, and fully take over post-sale.

jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Platform) • Paris Office

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Company: Escape : Leading AI Cybersecurity

  • Compensation: €75–90k base + 0.05% BSPCE depending on seniority and scope

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

Perks & Benefits

  • 💸 Significant equity (Stock Options/BSPCE) – become a core stakeholder in Escape's journey

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

  • Strong ownership: you fix the problem the moment you spot it Excellent communicator: able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineering stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Svelte expertise Security / DevSecOps background Early-stage startup experience

Ready to own the moat of an AI-native security company? Apply now to join Escape and ship offensive security to the teams that need it most.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Elektromobilität

Bei ubitricity treiben wir die Mobilitätswende voran und bauen und betreiben eines der größten öffentlichen Ladenetze für Elektrofahrzeuge in Europa. Auch in Deutschland wachsen wir weiter und suchen Verstärkung für unser Operations Team in Berlin.

Planung & Rollout

Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern

  • Du arbeitest mit Kommunen, Netzbetreibern, Planungsbüros, Lieferanten und Servicepartnern zusammen.

Prozesse & Verbesserungen

  • Du bringst deine Perspektive und Ideen ein und hilfst uns dabei, bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

Uns ist wichtig, was du lernen möchtest und wie du arbeitest. Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits alles kannst.

  • Ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, zum Beispiel in Stadt- oder Verkehrsplanung, Geografie, Bau- oder Elektrotechnik, Infrastruktur- oder Projektmanagement. Auch vergleichbare Hintergründe sind willkommen.

  • Freude daran, unterschiedliche Themen zu koordinieren und den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Analytisches Denken und Freude daran, Lösungen zu finden.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere Excel.

Schön, wenn du das schon mitbringst

Kein Muss. Wir freuen uns auch auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du diese Erfahrungen noch nicht gesammelt hast.

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Kommunen, Behörden oder Genehmigungsprozessen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Flexibles & hybrides Arbeiten
Flexible Arbeitszeiten geben dir Spielraum bei der Gestaltung deines Arbeitstages. Unser hybrides Modell verbindet persönliche Zusammenarbeit mit Flexibilität: 3 Tage pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Office und 2 Tage kannst du im Homeoffice arbeiten.

Benefits, die zu deinem Leben passen
Nicht jede*r braucht das Gleiche. Deshalb kannst du zwei aus drei Benefitsauswählen:

  • Sport & Wellbeing: Wir unterstützen deine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club und damit einen aktiven Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag.

Du arbeitest an einem Thema mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact und gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft von Elektromobilität, Smart Cities und Energiewende.

Ein internationales und kollegiales Team
Du wirst Teil eines Teams mit unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und Perspektiven und arbeitest mit Kolleg*innen und Partnern aus verschiedenen Bereichen und Ländern zusammen.

Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln
Wir möchten, dass du mit deiner Rolle wächst. Du erhältst Einblicke in den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Infrastrukturprojekte, kannst deine eigenen Ideen einbringen und mit zunehmender Erfahrung mehr Verantwortung übernehmen.

Arbeiten mitten in Berlin
Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich auf dem EUREF-Campus in Berlin-Schöneberg, einem Standort rund um die Themen Energie, Mobilität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Vielfalt macht uns besser
Wir glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Lebenswege unsere Zusammenarbeit besser machen. Deshalb möchten wir ein Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem sich alle willkommen fühlen und ihre individuellen Stärken einbringen können.

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

  • Collect and structure high-level requirements for new markets, products, and customers.

  • Support the translation of customer needs into TYTAN products and solutions.

  • Help coordinate hardware and software integrations with customers and partners.

  • Contribute to the preparation of technical documentation.

  • Work closely with Sales and Engineering to turn customer needs into technical solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with engineering software (e.g. CAD tools, or programming languages) is a plus.

  • Full professional proficiency in English; German is a plus.

  • Strong interest in, and previous involvement with, the aerospace industry, unmanned systems, or related fields are must to have

  • Ability to structure unclear inputs into clear requirements and documentation.

  • Ability to understand and follow complex end-to-end processes.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Availability of 20 hours per week for at least 3 months.

Why TYTAN?

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

Du übernimmst bei ryd eine etablierte Rechtsfunktion in Nachfolge unserer langjährigen General Counsel und berichtest direkt an den Chairman von ryd.

Die wesentlichen Strukturen und Prozesse der Rechtsfunktion sind aufgebaut. Als zentrale rechtliche Ansprechperson berätst Du die Geschäftsleitung, den Chairman und die Fachbereiche und begleitest ryd bei seinem weiteren Wachstum und der internationalen Expansion.

Die Position ist bewusst mit einer klaren Entwicklungsperspektive angelegt: Ziel ist die Weiterentwicklung zum General Counsel innerhalb von spätestens 18 Monaten. Voraussetzung hierfür ist die erfolgreiche Übernahme der Gesamtverantwortung für die Rechtsfunktion – einschließlich der gesellschaftsrechtlichen Themen sowie der Gremien- und Gesellschafterarbeit. Die konkreten Verantwortungsbereiche, Entwicklungsschritte und Ziele werden zu Beginn gemeinsam mit dem Chairman festgelegt.


  • Umfassende rechtliche Beratung der Geschäftsleitung, des Chairman und der Fachbereiche in allen für ryd relevanten Rechtsgebieten, insbesondere im Gesellschafts-, Handels-, Vertrags-, Wettbewerbs-, Zivil- und Arbeitsrecht
  • Gestaltung, Prüfung und Verhandlung nationaler und internationaler Verträge in deutscher und englischer Sprache sowie Verantwortung für das Vertragsmanagement
  • Rechtliche Begleitung gesellschaftsrechtlicher Themen, einschließlich Finanzierungsrunden, Transaktionen, Due-Diligence-Prozessen und Veränderungen der Konzernstruktur
  • Vorbereitung und rechtliche Begleitung der Gremien- und Gesellschafterarbeit
  • Rechtliche Betreuung der Auslandsgesellschaften sowie Begleitung des Eintritts von ryd in neue Märkte
  • Verantwortung für AGB, Nutzungsbedingungen und die rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen unserer App-, Web- und digitalen Produkte
  • Verantwortung für die Datenschutz-Compliance sowie Betreuung marken-, urheber- und sonstiger immaterialgüterrechtlicher Fragestellungen
  • Rechtliche Begleitung unserer Payment-Produkte und Geschäftsmodelle in Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Zahlungsdienstleistern und weiteren regulierten Partnern
  • Bewertung der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Anforderungen bei der Entwicklung neuer Produkte, Geschäftsmodelle und Märkte
  • Arbeitsrechtliche Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit HR
  • Betreuung von Rechtsstreitigkeiten sowie Auswahl, Beauftragung und Steuerung externer Kanzleien
  • Weiterentwicklung der Legal-Prozesse, Vertragsstandards und internen Governance-Strukturen mit dem Wachstum von ryd



Deine Qualifikationen

  • Volljurist:in mit mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung in einem Unternehmen und/oder einer wirtschaftsrechtlich ausgerichteten Kanzlei
  • Breite generalistische juristische Aufstellung und ausgeprägtes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche und unternehmerische Zusammenhänge
  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Gestaltung und Verhandlung komplexer Verträge
  • Fähigkeit, rechtliche Risiken klar einzuordnen und zugleich pragmatische und geschäftsorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels

  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
